name: vectormagic-mcp-server
description: Vectorize any bitmap into editable SVG, AI, EPS, PDF, DXF or EMF with Vector Magic Desktop Edition on Windows. Not affiliated with Vector Magic, Inc.
long_description:
Vector Magic Bridge lets Claude drive the Vector Magic Desktop Edition you already have installed on Windows (tested with 1.15).

- **Vectorize** PNG, JPG, GIF, BMP, TIFF, PSD, TGA, PCX, JP2, XPM and more.
- **Export** editable SVG, AI, EPS, PDF, DXF or EMF, or re-render PNG/JPG/BMP/TIF at 1x, 2x or 4x.
- **Tune** level of detail, colour mode, shape layering, strokes and DXF curve mode.
- **Batch** whole folders, and get a preview plus a summary of what Vector Magic detected.

Vector Magic has no command line, so the connector starts its own off-screen Vector Magic window and drives it; windows you have open are never touched, and your Vector Magic settings are restored after every run. Everything runs locally with no network access. Requires a licensed copy of Vector Magic Desktop Edition. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Vector Magic, Inc.
